title: Rules pass recommendations
description: What the rules pass (the second, smaller model step) emits: one recommendation per new module finding it was given. Location, check id and the cap on level come from the module finding, never from here: the poster takes them from the module's result by fingerprint.

summary.description: One or two sentences on what the module findings add to the review.

fingerprint.description: The module finding's fingerprint, exactly as given.

action.description: add: the first pass missed it, post it. overlap: a first-pass finding already covers the same problem; name it in overlapsWith. dismiss: a false positive; say why in evidence.

overlapsWith.description: With overlap: the id of the first-pass finding (B1, F2, …).
